Description: Fragments of a plaster wall inscription in a local Aramaic-related script, telling of night visions of doom received by 'Balaam son of Beor, a seer of the gods.' It was found shattered by an earthquake in a building at Deir Alla in the Jordan Valley.
BiblicalSignificance: Outside the Bible, Balaam was remembered centuries later and in another country as a famous seer, exactly the reputation Numbers describes. The inscription does not retell the talking donkey, but it confirms Balaam son of Beor was a real figure of regional renown, remembered for words God gave him.
